description: Filter contact form spam and unwanted sales pitches on HighLevel, WordPress, HubSpot, and custom websites. Set rules for each site and review blocked submissions. Rule-based bot blocking is free; message screening costs $0.01 per submission on the pay-as-you-go plan. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

positive.description: Check a form submission for spam or a sales pitch
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the submission against screening rules and evaluates the message if needed. Returns blocked_spam or verified_lead, reason codes, and the workflow branch.
positive.prompt: Screen this contact form message for pacific-coast-detailing: 'Hi, we can rank your detailing website #1 on Google for $199/mo! Visit https://seo-agency.biz'

positive.description: Review blocked spam from the last seven days
positive.expected_behavior: Returns blocked submission counts by screening stage and reason for the requested date range.
positive.prompt: Show our blocked contact form spam report for pacific-coast-detailing over the last 7 days.

positive.description: Check a site's active screening rules
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the server-side spam guard policy including allowedCountries, allowedPhoneFormats, URL blocking rules, and active formType preset.
positive.prompt: Inspect the active contact form spam policy and quote_request preset for pacific-coast-detailing.

positive.expected_behavior: Previews updated country, phone format, URL, and keyword rules in dry-run mode without mutating production settings.
positive.prompt: Preview updating our site spam policy for pacific-coast-detailing to allow US and CA countries and block URLs in messages.

positive.description: Generate website and workflow setup instructions
positive.expected_behavior: Generates the 1-line guard.js script tag and HighLevel/HubSpot webhook endpoints for the target site.
